considerations.sourcePassage: But just to say that within other taxa, so this is a comparison of the incidence of different types of tumors in things like birds and reptiles in comparison to mammals. considerations.sourcePassage: The real takeaway here is that any organism or any animal that has-- any organism, rather, that is multicellular and has a differentiation program can end up with a problem in differentiation, and end up with a tumor and with that disease. So oysters, flies, clams, crabs, all of these animals, they have differentiation programs, and they can all get tumors and cancer. So you can really consider, as I said, cancer as a disease of development and differentiation.
